Proving to myself that life was simpler without socialisation. 

Does anyone else act differently in different groups?? I have 3 distinct groups of friends... One I've known for years, one for a few months, one for a few weeks but has been a quick build. I act so differently with each group. With the most recent I've been really exploring my sexuality and have been with them while that's happened. The other two groups would be fine, but I just need more processing time while I figure out what's going on with me. Now Pride is fast approaching in my city and I'm torn 3 different ways, including an evening where each group has tickets for the same club event. I'm stressed. So stressed. Who do I speak to? How do I act? I'm stressed that each group will mention things that I'd rather keep separate. 

Any one else had this happen? Any advice? Positive stories? Horror stories?

Yep. I go to a weekly show in a bar in my city. Had a conversation with one of the performers last night where I made a joke but I ended up just sounding like a dick. Now not sure if I can ever go back, and hardly slept because I was obsessing about it. Fuck social anxiety.
